mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTENT_REPORT (TARGET_TYPE_CODE, POST_ID, COMMENT_ID, REPORTER_USER_ID, REASON_CODE, DETAIL_TEXT, STATUS_CODE, REPORTED_AT) VALUES (#{targetTypeCode}, #{postId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{commentId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{reporterUserId}, #{reasonCode}, #{detailText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'RECEIVED', #{reportedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_REPORT R WHERE AND R.STATUS_CODE IN ('RECEIVED', 'IN_REVIEW')

mapper.sql: SELECT R.REPORT_ID AS reportId, R.TARGET_TYPE_CODE AS targetTypeCode, R.POST_ID AS postId, R.COMMENT_ID AS commentId, C.POST_ID AS parentPostId, R.REASON_CODE AS reasonCode, R.DETAIL_TEXT AS detailText, R.STATUS_CODE AS statusCode, R.RESULT_CODE AS resultCode, R.HANDLER_MEMO AS handlerMemo, R.REPORTED_AT AS reportedAt, R.HANDLED_AT AS handledAt, U.NICKNAME AS reporterNickname, CASE WHEN U.USER_ID IS NULL OR U.ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS reporterWithdrawn, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE_CODE = 'POST' THEN P.TITLE ELSE SUBSTR(C.CONTENT, 1, 50) END AS targetText, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE_CODE = 'POST' THEN P.STATUS_CODE ELSE C.STATUS_CODE END AS targetStatusCode FROM CONTENT_REPORT R LEFT JOIN BOARD_POST P ON P.POST_ID = R.POST_ID LEFT JOIN BOARD_COMMENT C ON C.COMMENT_ID = R.COMMENT_ID LEFT JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = R.REPORTER_USER_ID
